name.description: Custom name for the named pipe. Resulting path will be TMP/pipectl.UID.NAME.pipe. Default is 'default'.

path.description: Full path for the named pipe. If empty, pipectl determines the path using TMPDIR or /tmp. Corresponds to -p flag.

force.description: Force overwrite an existing named pipe. Only usable with -o (output/daemon mode). Corresponds to -f flag.

lock.description: Use flock(2) to synchronize writes to the pipe. Only usable with -i (input mode). Corresponds to -l flag.

tmp_dir.description: Base directory for pipe creation when path is not explicitly set. Corresponds to TMPDIR environment variable or fallback.

daemon_command.description: The long-lived process to which stdin is fed. Used in output mode (-o). Pipectl opens the pipe and feeds its contents to this command's stdin.

input_commands.description: List of shell commands to execute in input mode (-i) to write data to the named pipe. Each item is a string command.
